techniques.evidence: features/graph/trailPath.ts:201 Takes an array of edge values and returns adjacency data structures purely, without touching any store or network.
features/graph/graphActions.ts:71 Asynchronous execution and input validation are restricted to server action boundaries at the edge.

features/graph/permalink.ts:473 Structural mirror type declared at the edge lets the card formatter run in pure unit tests without importing the server loader.
features/graph/oneDefinition.test.ts:20 Guards against duplicate encodings across modules, ensuring canonical definitions like edgeKey have a single owner.

features/graph/trailPath.ts:52 Pins the pathfinding search constants and algorithm behavior under an explicit versioned reference asserted by tests.
